conclusion: WooCommerce Bookings is not installed in the benchmark site, so this is not runtime latency coverage. Installed gateway sources still expose concrete Bookings hot paths to benchmark once the commercial extension fixture is available: WooPayments multicurrency price conversion filters, WooPayments and Stripe express-checkout booking-cart cleanup, PayPal button/cart simulation for booking products, and PayPal order-created booking generation.

runtime_status.reason_not_measured: The benchmark container does not have WooCommerce Bookings loaded, so booking calendar, booking cost, in-cart booking, and booking checkout behavior cannot be timed honestly.

syntax.command: php -l selected Bookings compatibility source files copied from the running container
syntax.result: No syntax errors detected in WooPayments WooCommerceBookings.php, PayPal CartProductsHelper.php, PayPal CompatModule.php, Stripe express checkout ajax handler, and Stripe express checkout helper.

runtime_benchmark.reason: WooCommerce Bookings APIs are absent in the benchmark runtime.

hot_paths.static_finding: When WC_Bookings exists, WooPayments attaches filters to calculated booking cost, block/cost/display cost, person costs, resource costs, cost-rule costs, and AJAX booking cost calculation. get_price() performs backtrace checks for WC_Cart->add_to_cart and WC_Bookings_Cost_Calculation::calculate_booking_cost before calling MultiCurrency::get_price(). Resource costs are converted by looping each resource price through get_price().
hot_paths.performance_risk: The existing gateway profile already showed WooPayments multicurrency adding about 40k calls on an 800-variation product page. Bookings cost calculation can multiply conversion calls across resources, persons, blocks, and cost rules, with backtrace checks in each get_price() call.
hot_paths.developer_handoff: Benchmark wc_bookings_calculate_costs and booking add-to-cart for bookable products with 1/10/100 resources, 1/5/20 person types, and layered cost rules. Capture function counts for WooCommerceBookings::get_price, Utils::is_call_in_backtrace, MultiCurrency::get_price, get_selected_currency, and get_stored_currency_code.

hot_paths.static_finding: The express checkout AJAX add-to-cart path empties the cart, treats booking products as supported, adds the booking product to the cart, calculates totals, then reads the first cart item's booking _booking_id to return to the browser.
hot_paths.performance_risk: For Bookings, WC_Cart::add_to_cart can trigger booking validation/cost/in-cart reservation work before calculate_totals. The helper assumes a single booking item and scans only the first cart item for the booking id.
hot_paths.developer_handoff: Benchmark the WooPayments express checkout add-to-cart AJAX path with booking products that require resource/person/cost calculation. Separate Bookings add_to_cart/cost time from WooPayments display-item construction and total calculation.

hot_paths.area: Stripe express checkout booking cleanup and totals
hot_paths.static_finding: Before express-checkout add-to-cart, Stripe reads existing booking ids from the cart, empties the cart, then calls wc-booking-remove-inactive-cart for each previous in-cart booking id. The helper scans all cart items and returns unique booking ids. Clear-cart accepts one booking_id and triggers the same removal action.
hot_paths.performance_risk: The path adds booking cleanup work around every express-checkout cart reset. With multi-item or repeatedly changed booking carts, removal hooks can add booking-post updates and availability/reservation side effects before the normal cart totals work.
hot_paths.developer_handoff: Benchmark Stripe express checkout add-to-cart/clear-cart with one and many in-cart booking ids. Capture time and SQL behind wc-booking-remove-inactive-cart separately from cart total calculation.

hot_paths.area: PayPal button booking product cart addition
hot_paths.static_finding: PayPal parses product request data into WC product objects, routes booking products to add_booking_product(), calls wc_bookings_get_posted_data(), and adds the product to the configured cart with booking cart item data and quantity 1.
hot_paths.performance_risk: wc_bookings_get_posted_data and WC_Cart::add_to_cart are the point where Bookings validation, availability checks, cost calculation, in-cart booking creation, and gateway button overhead meet.
hot_paths.developer_handoff: Profile PayPal product button and Apple Pay booking requests with resource/person/cost-heavy products. Capture wc_bookings_get_posted_data, WC_Cart::add_to_cart, WC_Cart::calculate_totals, and PayPal request parsing separately.

hot_paths.area: PayPal isolated cart simulation for complex product totals
hot_paths.static_finding: PayPal's simulate-cart endpoint is explicitly used for complex product types including bookings. It creates a throwaway WC_Cart with session initialization disabled, adds products through CartProductsHelper, calculates totals, restores notices, removes simulated cart items, and restores CartProductsHelper to the real cart.
hot_paths.performance_risk: A booking product can pay full booking posted-data/add-to-cart/totals cost during simulation before the real checkout/order path runs. Cleanup uses remove_cart_items(), which can also fire cart/booking hooks.
hot_paths.developer_handoff: Benchmark ppc-simulate-cart with booking products and compare it with the final add-to-cart/order request. Count duplicate Bookings cost/availability calculations and quantify cleanup hook cost.

hot_paths.static_finding: When WC_Bookings is active, PayPal hooks order-created-from-cart. It loops every cart item with booking data and, inside that, loops every WC order item. For each product order item that is a booking product, it builds booking data from the cart item and calls create_wc_booking(..., 'unpaid').
hot_paths.performance_risk: The nested cart-item x order-item loop can over-scan on orders with many items, and create_wc_booking adds Bookings persistence work after the PayPal order has already been created.
hot_paths.developer_handoff: Benchmark PayPal order creation with 1, 10, and 50 booking line items plus non-booking line items. Capture wc_get_product, is_wc_booking_product, create_wc_booking, order-item iteration, and resulting post/meta writes.

minimum_runtime_fixture_needed: WooCommerce Bookings extension loaded with WC_Bookings, WC_Product_Booking, wc_bookings_get_posted_data, is_wc_booking_product, and create_wc_booking available
Bookable products with resource, person, availability, blocked range, and cost-rule complexity scaled independently
Standard add-to-cart and checkout requests containing booking line items
WooPayments multicurrency enabled with at least one non-default selected currency
WooPayments express checkout booking AJAX request
Stripe express checkout booking add-to-cart and clear-cart requests
PayPal product button, Apple Pay, simulate-cart, and order-created-from-cart booking requests
